title: Celestial AI
summary: San Jose company using photonics to build a memory fabric for AI accelerators.
bodyHtml:
Celestial AI's Photonic Fabric connects accelerators to memory across a rack, aiming to break the capacity wall that forces models to be split across many chips.

The company targets disaggregated memory pools, where compute and memory scale independently.

Why it matters

  • Photonic memory fabric
  • Rack-scale memory pooling
  • Accelerator integration
